note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We plan to outsource customer support to a vendor that would handle 120,000 customer records. Our vendor questionnaire has 80 controls.

answers.common.decision: Whether to sign with the vendor and on what conditions; the vendor risk committee decides.
answers.common.deadline: The committee meets in three weeks.
answers.common.materials: The vendor fully met 64 controls, partly met 10 and did not meet 6. The controls not met include encryption of stored data and a tested disaster recovery plan. The vendor hosts its systems with a subcontractor we have not assessed. Our policy requires at least 90% of controls met for a critical vendor.
answers.risk-audit-controls.framework: Our third-party risk policy and its vendor questionnaire.
answers.risk-audit-controls.scope: The proposed customer-support vendor, before the contract is signed.
